_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Air Traffic Services Systems Requirements and Objectives
summary: Describes the operational environment characteristics and safety and interoperability requirements for aircraft, communications network, and ATS ground systems, used to develop and substantiate interoperability of the contractor's end-to-end ATS data link communication.
use_relationship:
The Air Traffic Service Systems Requirements and Objectives (ATS SR&O) describes certain characteristics of the operational environment and the safety and interoperability requirements for the system and functions that support the ATS.  The ATS SR&O also allocates the safety and interoperability requirements to the aircraft, communications network, ATS ground systems.  The ATS SR&O will be used to develop the contractor's end-to-end ATS data link communication.  It will substantiate interoperability of the end-to-end system.

This Data item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the contract.

Radio Technical Commission for Aeronautics (RTCA) documents may be obtained through http://www.rtca.org/onlinecart/ or by mail from RTCA, Inc., 1828 L Street, NW, Suite 805, Washington, DC 20036.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The ATS SR&O shall contain the information needed to support the United States Air Force (USAF) operational approval for the overall ATS function.

children.title: The ATS SR&O shall cover the contractor's overall integration into the ATS infrastructure
children.content: IAW RTCA DO-258, "Interoperability Requirements for ATS Applications Using ARINC 622 Data Communications"; RTCA DO-264,"Guidelines for Approval of the Provision and Use of Air Traffic Services Supported by Data Communications"; and RTCA DO-305, "Future Air Navigation System 1/A (FANS 1/A)-Aeronautical Telecommunications Network (ATN) Interoperability Standard".  The ATS SR&O shall as a minimum:

children.title: Define interfaces between airborne, satellite, and ground environments
Document interface decisions made during development
Document necessary changes or clarifications to existing industry requirements
Document limitations or exceptions of the ATS implementation
Describe the overall requirements for the ATS function
children.content: Describe the overall requirements for the ATS function as they relate to the aircraft.

children.title: Support safety or failure analysis by identifying those requirements
children.content: Support safety or failure analysis by identifying those requirements which substantiate assumptions of the analysis.

children.title: Allocate the requirements to the aircraft systems environment
children.content: Allocate the requirements to the aircraft systems environment and non-aircraft environment.

children.title: Allocate the aircraft systems requirements to the functional subsystem
